This is the standalone privacy policy for the XMAS 2027 application. It is separate from, and does not replace, the conference registration, payment, cancellation, or refund policy published by the XMAS 2027 Organizing Committee.

1. Scope and roles

XMAS 2027 is the conference companion application for the Eighth Xiamen Symposium on Marine Environmental Sciences.

  • Publisher and technical operator: Zheng Jiang / CodexBrian, using the developer accounts identified on the relevant app store listing.
  • Conference content provider: XMAS 2027 Organizing Committee.
  • Privacy and support contact: xmas@xmu.edu.cn, +86-592-2181571.

2. Summary

No account. No advertising or analytics. No transmission of personal app data to the publisher. The program, presentation details, maps, and announcements are bundled with the application. Personal schedule and preference data stay on the device. The official conference homepage and presentation pages open in the system browser after a tap.

3. Information stored on the device

InformationPurpose
Saved session identifiersShow bookmarked sessions and personal schedule items.
Personal agenda items and optional notesLet the user organize attendance and record notes.
Checklist progressRemember completed conference-preparation items.
Notification preferenceRemember whether optional local reminders are enabled.
Onboarding and display settingsPreserve the user's app state.
A random local installation identifier on some editionsKeep local records associated with the same installation. It is not an advertising identifier and is not transmitted.

This information is used only to provide the features described above. The application does not send it to a conference API, advertising network, analytics service, or the publisher.

On supported iOS versions, private note, agenda, and legacy profile files are excluded from device backups where technically possible. System-managed data, including Keychain values and backups created by earlier app versions, may be retained by the operating system until removed by the system, a later app action, or a compatible reinstall.

4. Information we do not collect

  • Name, email address, password, or other account credentials
  • Device address book or contacts
  • Precise or approximate location
  • Camera or microphone content
  • Health or biometric data
  • Payment-card, banking, registration-payment, or order information
  • Passport, visa, or other identity documents
  • Advertising identifiers
  • Behavioral analytics, tracking events, or cross-app activity
  • Remote crash reports or diagnostics used for tracking

The application does not create an attendee account and does not process conference registration or payment.

5. Conference program and people directory

The application includes conference content supplied or approved by the organizer, including session titles, rooms, times, presentation titles, and the names, affiliations, roles, and academic titles of speakers and conveners.

This directory is part of the official conference program. It is not created from the device, attendance history, location, or behavior of the person using the application. The application does not monitor who views a directory entry.

Requests concerning the accuracy, correction, or removal of a directory entry should be sent to xmas@xmu.edu.cn.

6. Network behavior

All three editions read conference content from the installation package. Android and HarmonyOS do not request Internet permission, and their embedded web engines block network loading. The system browser handles the official conference links after a tap. The app displays contact details as text.

When the user opens an official conference page, that website is controlled by the conference organizer and may receive standard network information such as the device IP address under its own privacy practices. The app does not load or monitor that page.

7. Device permissions and platform features

Notifications

The iOS edition may request notification permission when the user enables optional session reminders. Reminders are scheduled locally on the device. The application does not register for remote push notifications.

Calendar and Reminders

The iOS edition may request Calendar or Reminders access when the user enables those optional features. The application uses on-device containers and does not upload calendar or reminder data. Users can deny these permissions and continue using the bundled program.

Location, contacts, camera, and microphone

The application does not request access to location, device contacts, the camera, or the microphone.

8. Sharing and third parties

The publisher does not receive or share locally stored app data. The application contains no third-party advertising, analytics, tracking, crash-reporting, or remote account SDK.

Apple, Google, Huawei, and other distribution platforms may process account, download, payment, or diagnostic information under their own terms when a user downloads, updates, or reviews the application. That processing is controlled by the relevant platform, not by the application.

9. Retention and deletion

Local app data remains on the device until the user deletes individual items, clears the relevant app data, or uninstalls the application. The publisher does not maintain a server-side copy of this local data.

Uninstalling the application removes its ordinary local application container. Some values managed by the operating system, including Keychain entries or platform backups, may remain until removed by the system or a later compatible app action.

10. Security

The application uses the operating system's application sandbox and protected local storage mechanisms. No method of storage is completely secure, so users should protect access to their device and keep the operating system current.

11. Children

The application is an educational conference tool and is not directed to children. The publisher does not knowingly collect personal information from children through the application.

12. International use

The application does not transmit locally stored app data to the publisher or conference server, so the publisher does not transfer that data internationally. App store availability and platform account processing are governed by the relevant distribution platform and the user's storefront.

13. Changes to this policy

Material changes will be reflected in a revised policy with a new effective date and, where appropriate, in the application release notes. Continuing to use the application after an updated policy takes effect means that the updated policy applies to the new version.

14. Contact

XMAS 2027 privacy and support contact
Email: xmas@xmu.edu.cn
Telephone: +86-592-2181571
Support: mel-xmas.net/contact_us.html
Official website: mel-xmas.net
本文件是 XMAS 2027 App 的独立隐私政策，与第八届厦门海洋环境科学大会组委会发布的会议注册、付款、取消及退款政策相互独立，不替代后者。

一、适用范围与角色

XMAS 2027 是第八届厦门海洋环境科学大会的移动参会助手。

  • 发布及技术运营主体：姜正 / CodexBrian，使用相应应用商店页面所示开发者账号。
  • 大会内容提供方：第八届厦门海洋环境科学大会组委会。
  • 隐私与支持联系方式：xmas@xmu.edu.cn，+86-592-2181571。

二、概要

无需账号，不含广告、行为分析或追踪，不向发布者传输 App 内的个人数据。 会议议程、报告信息、地图和公告均随安装包提供。个人日程和偏好数据保存在设备本地。用户点击大会官网或对应报告链接后，由系统浏览器打开。

三、仅保存在设备本地的信息

信息用途
收藏场次的标识符展示收藏场次和个人日程。
用户创建的个人日程及可选备注帮助用户安排参会和记录笔记。
参会清单完成状态记住已完成的会前准备事项。
通知开关偏好记住用户是否启用本地提醒。
首次使用及显示设置保持 App 的正常使用状态。
部分版本生成的随机本地安装标识符使同一安装产生的本地记录保持一致。该标识符不是广告标识符，也不会被传输。

上述信息仅用于提供相应功能。App 不会向会议接口、广告平台、分析服务或发布者发送这些信息。

在支持该功能的 iOS 版本中，私人备注、个人日程和旧版名片文件会在技术可行范围内排除于设备备份之外。由操作系统管理的数据，包括钥匙串内容及旧版本产生的备份，可能由系统保留，直至被系统、后续 App 操作或兼容重装流程删除。

四、我们不收集的信息

  • 姓名、电子邮箱、密码或其他账号凭证
  • 设备通讯录或联系人
  • 精确或大致位置
  • 相机或麦克风内容
  • 健康或生物识别信息
  • 支付卡、银行、注册缴费或订单信息
  • 护照、签证或其他身份证明文件
  • 广告标识符
  • 行为分析、追踪事件或跨 App 活动
  • 用于追踪的远程崩溃报告或诊断信息

App 不创建参会者账号，也不处理会议注册或付款。

五、会议议程与人员目录

App 包含由大会组委会提供或批准的内容，包括场次名称、会议室、时间、报告名称，以及报告人和召集人的姓名、单位、角色与学术职称。

人员目录属于官方会议议程的一部分，并非根据使用者的设备、签到记录、位置或行为生成。App 不会监测谁查看了某个目录条目。

如需核对、更正或删除人员目录信息，请联系组委会：xmas@xmu.edu.cn。

六、联网行为

三个平台均从安装包读取会议内容。Android 和 HarmonyOS 不申请联网权限，内置网页引擎禁止网络加载。官网链接仅在用户点击后交给系统浏览器。联系方式以文本显示。

用户打开大会官网页面后，该网站由大会组委会控制，可能依据其自身隐私规则接收设备 IP 地址等常规网络信息。App 不加载或监测该页面。

七、设备权限与平台功能

通知

iOS 版本可能在用户启用可选场次提醒时申请通知权限。提醒仅在设备本地安排。App 不注册远程推送通知。

日历与提醒事项

iOS 版本可能在用户启用相应可选功能时申请日历或提醒事项权限。App 仅使用设备本地的容器，不上传日历或提醒事项数据。用户可以拒绝授权，并继续使用随包会议内容。

定位、通讯录、相机与麦克风

App 不申请定位、设备通讯录、相机或麦克风权限。

八、共享与第三方

发布者不会接收或共享本地 App 数据。App 不包含第三方广告、分析、追踪、崩溃上报或远程账号 SDK。

当用户通过 Apple、Google、华为等分发平台下载、更新或评价 App 时，相应平台可能依据其自身条款处理账号、下载、付款或诊断信息。该处理由相应平台控制，并非由 App 执行。

九、保存与删除

本地 App 数据会一直保存在设备上，直至用户删除相应条目、清除 App 数据或卸载 App。发布者不保留这些本地数据的服务器副本。

卸载 App 会删除普通的本地应用容器。由操作系统管理的部分内容，包括钥匙串条目或平台备份，可能保留至被系统或后续兼容的 App 操作删除。

十、安全

App 使用操作系统提供的应用沙盒及受保护的本地存储机制。任何存储方式都无法保证绝对安全，用户应保护设备访问权限并及时更新操作系统。

十一、未成年人

App 是学术会议辅助工具，不面向儿童。发布者不会通过 App 主动收集儿童个人信息。

十二、国际使用

App 不会将本地保存的数据发送给发布者或会议服务器，因此发布者不会对这些数据进行跨境传输。App 的商店供应范围及平台账号处理受相应分发平台和用户所在商店地区规则约束。

十三、政策更新

如数据处理方式发生实质变化，我们会更新政策、标注新的生效日期，并在适当情况下同步修改 App 更新说明。更新后的政策生效后继续使用新版本 App，即适用更新后的政策。

十四、联系我们
